summary: Session 14 completed OAuth/OIDC authentication, admin panel with user approval workflow, and production-ready Nix deployment using gomod2nix following the goroutinely/Tandoor patterns.

completed_tasks.title: OAuth/OIDC Authentication
completed_tasks.outcome: Added auth.go with support for Authentik, Authelia, Google, GitHub OAuth providers.
completed_tasks.notes: First user is auto-admin. JWT-based sessions. Skip-auth mode for development.

completed_tasks.title: Admin Panel
completed_tasks.outcome: Created admin.html and admin.go for user management.
completed_tasks.notes: Features: approve/reject users, toggle admin status, delete users, view stats.

completed_tasks.title: Nix/NixOS Deployment
completed_tasks.outcome: Production-ready NixOS module and flake using gomod2nix.
completed_tasks.notes: Using buildGoApplication with gomod2nix.toml. Options: database.createLocally, ai.ollama, ai.rembg, ai.acceleration.

completed_tasks.title: Docker Compose
completed_tasks.notes: Includes: gothreads, postgres, minio, ollama (profile: ai), rembg (profile: ai).

completed_tasks.title: Route Groups
completed_tasks.outcome: Migrated to go-pkgz/routegroup following goroutinely pattern.
completed_tasks.notes: Uses route groups with middleware for auth and admin routes.
